Teenager Dies After Mother Stops Her From Making Social Media Reel

A teenage girl in Chandauli reportedly died by jumping into a canal in Mirzapur after her mother prevented her from creating a social media reel. Her body was recovered, and the incident has caused grief within her family. The event highlights potential pressures and conflicts arising from social media use among young people.
